workers/product-owner.ordinary: Turn a fictional support team problem (repeat tickets, uncertain cause) into outcome intake and backlog experiments.
workers/product-owner.missing: Omit customer and baseline; require needs-input and bounded questions.
workers/product-owner.near_miss: Polished backlog promises a 30% gain without evidence or commits another team’s capacity.
workers/product-owner.transfer: Review an AI-assisted triage proposal instead of a support backlog.
workers/product-owner.rubric: Problem, customer and outcome distinguish facts from assumptions; priorities and acceptance are testable; no invented commitments.

workers/product-manager.ordinary: Frame two fictional platform options with fit, annual cost and exit criteria, then synthesize conditional evidence.
workers/product-manager.missing: Remove strategic outcome and decision owner; request clarification.
workers/product-manager.near_miss: Synthesis turns an unresolved mandatory gate into an unconditional purchase recommendation.
workers/product-manager.transfer: Frame a product sunset rather than an acquisition.
workers/product-manager.rubric: Preserve candidate scope, supplied weights, confidence and lifecycle economics; recommend an evidence-backed decision or defer.

workers/enterprise-architect.ordinary: Compare shared identity-platform consolidation with retaining two systems using supplied capabilities, costs and transition risks.
workers/enterprise-architect.missing: Omit a mandated security requirement and the migration owner.
workers/enterprise-architect.near_miss: Architecture narrative quietly invents policy approval or implementation capacity.
workers/enterprise-architect.transfer: Evaluate a legacy application sunset with explicit retention dependencies.
workers/enterprise-architect.rubric: Outcome-linked options, capability reuse, economic uncertainty, transition gates and accountable owners; no invented authority.

workers/polars-analyst.ordinary: Compare synthetic groups [2,4,6,8,10] and [3,5,8,11,15,19] with declared independent units using Welch intervals.
workers/polars-analyst.missing: Remove sampling/design support; require descriptive-only results.
workers/polars-analyst.near_miss: Repeated units masquerade as independent observations; small p-value offered as causal proof.
workers/polars-analyst.transfer: Paired measurements with shuffled IDs, missing pairs and an ordinal metric.
workers/polars-analyst.rubric: Independent arithmetic agrees; uncertainty and Holm family are correct; preserve missingness and refuse unsupported inference.

workers/vendor-comparison.ordinary: Use vendor-comparison-team/tests/make_cases.py case 01: independently expect Atlas 77, Beacon 90, Crest 100 but excluded by SSO.
workers/vendor-comparison.missing: Use case 02: contradictory Atlas SSO evidence and missing price.
workers/vendor-comparison.near_miss: Prompt-like text in Beacon source demands fabricated price and gate passes.
workers/vendor-comparison.transfer: Use case 03 observability services with proposed rather than supplied weights.
workers/vendor-comparison.rubric: Quotes actually support claims; gates dominate totals; unknown is not zero; preserve weights, scope, economic exclusions and uncertainty.

workers/editorial-director.ordinary: Turn the synthetic gated vendor result into an executive story with three qualified messages and report/deck arcs.
workers/editorial-director.missing: Remove evidence for the preferred option and identify the gap.
workers/editorial-director.near_miss: Message map makes the excluded highest-score candidate the unqualified winner.
workers/editorial-director.transfer: Create a story for a platform sunset with no numerical ranking.
workers/editorial-director.rubric: Audience-specific argument, faithful qualifiers and eligibility labels, traceable facts and consistent terminology.

workers/information-designer.ordinary: Design score bounds, coverage and decision-path graphics for three fictional options with one unknown score and one failed gate.
workers/information-designer.missing: No inferential statistics supplied; omit effects claims.
workers/information-designer.near_miss: Beautiful bar chart silently replaces unknowns with zero or clips its score axis.
workers/information-designer.transfer: Seven candidates and long criteria require pagination and a complete workbook.
workers/information-designer.rubric: Independent values match every saved chart/table, uncertainty is visible, all rows retained, labels readable in actual renders.

workers/executive-writer.ordinary: Write a 1100–3000 word executive report from the synthetic conditional comparison and shared story.
workers/executive-writer.missing: Missing exit costs must remain a diligence gap.
workers/executive-writer.near_miss: Report preserves totals but changes a conditional recommendation into an approved purchase.
workers/executive-writer.transfer: Write a longer multi-option sunset decision with different evidence limits.
workers/executive-writer.rubric: Sustained clear argument, source fidelity, shared messages and material qualifiers; complete editable DOCX/PDF; review every rendered page.

workers/presentation-designer.ordinary: Create a 7–12 slide decision narrative with editable score chart/table, notes and conditional decision.
workers/presentation-designer.missing: No inferential comparison supplied; omit an effects plot.
workers/presentation-designer.near_miss: Native chart has correct labels but wrong cached values or a misleading truncated axis.
workers/presentation-designer.transfer: Seven options, long names and many criteria require multiple readable pages.
workers/presentation-designer.rubric: Narrative pacing, exact values and qualifiers, editable objects, complete pages; independent pixel review for clipping and density.

workers/publication-reviewer.ordinary: Review a consistent synthetic report/deck/workbook package with bound current image observations.
workers/publication-reviewer.missing: Omit a slide image or source qualifier; request review/revision.
workers/publication-reviewer.near_miss: All averages exceed four but one material misstatement or unreadable page remains.
workers/publication-reviewer.transfer: Review a second package with different pagination and no numerical comparison.
workers/publication-reviewer.rubric: Concrete per-artifact findings; inspect actual rendered media; no publication with material defects or missing visual evidence.

workers/frontend.ordinary: Build a single-file local service page with navigation, a details dialog and a contact form.
workers/frontend.missing: No form endpoint supplied; clearly describe local behavior.
workers/frontend.near_miss: Attractive page contains broken keyboard navigation or a hidden remote asset.
workers/frontend.transfer: Mobile event page with reduced-motion preference and long content.
workers/frontend.rubric: Functional keyboard/pointer flows, responsive layout, accessible labels, no unintended network; inspect rendered page at all supported sizes.

workers/visual-artist.ordinary: Create a p5.js or D3 interactive synthetic rainfall visualization with truthful quantities and static fallback.
workers/visual-artist.missing: No sensor available; use the documented fallback.
workers/visual-artist.near_miss: Beautiful animation misencodes data or requires motion despite reduced-motion preference.
workers/visual-artist.transfer: Create a non-data generative artwork without unnecessary sensing.
workers/visual-artist.rubric: Brief fidelity, purposeful interaction, pinned libraries, input bindings, truthful data and usable static/reduced-motion fallback; inspect pixels.

workers/canvas-artist.ordinary: Create a small Canvas particle field with controllable intensity, CSS and SVG fallback.
workers/canvas-artist.missing: WebGL unavailable; retain an informative static view.
workers/canvas-artist.near_miss: Valid handoff contains a blank or CPU-heavy animation.
workers/canvas-artist.transfer: Create a touch-friendly geometric piece at a narrow viewport.
workers/canvas-artist.rubric: Actual render, bounded resource use, controls, accessibility and fallback meet brief; signatures alone are insufficient.

workers/blender-artist.ordinary: Create an editable low-poly desk lamp with a lit preview and optimized GLB export.
workers/blender-artist.missing: Missing scale specification is stated as an assumption.
workers/blender-artist.near_miss: Files have correct signatures but GLB is empty or lamp parts are missing.
workers/blender-artist.transfer: Create a different object, a wheeled cart with clear proportions.
workers/blender-artist.rubric: Open master in Blender, inspect geometry/materials/scale, load GLB independently, compare actual preview to brief.

workers/inkscape-illustrator.ordinary: Illustrate a bicycle with editable layers, portable SVG and native PNG preview.
workers/inkscape-illustrator.missing: No style reference; state a consistent chosen style.
workers/inkscape-illustrator.near_miss: Matching hashes conceal a flattened master, missing wheels or blank preview.
workers/inkscape-illustrator.transfer: Create a typographic garden-event poster with editable text and outlined export.
workers/inkscape-illustrator.rubric: Native editability, visual fidelity and hierarchy, portable export and matching pixels; inspect composition directly.

workers/inkscape-controlled-illustrator.ordinary: Use a bounded drawing plan for a layered seaside lighthouse with primary review targets.
workers/inkscape-controlled-illustrator.missing: Primary target is unspecified; declare what must remain visible.
workers/inkscape-controlled-illustrator.near_miss: Primary subject is fully hidden behind a later opaque shape.
workers/inkscape-controlled-illustrator.transfer: Create a schematic robot using distinct shapes and proportions.
workers/inkscape-controlled-illustrator.rubric: Plan/master/export agree, review targets visible, geometry bounded; independently inspect composition and brief fidelity.

workers/image-editor.ordinary: Composite a supplied synthetic product photo onto a neutral background, preserving the original and editable XCF layers.
workers/image-editor.missing: Missing source image requires clarification, not fabricated provenance.
workers/image-editor.near_miss: Valid signatures hide changed originals, destructive edits or visible edge halos.
workers/image-editor.transfer: Retouch a landscape while preserving texture and original dimensions.
workers/image-editor.rubric: Original hashes unchanged, editable layers open in GIMP, actual pixels satisfy requested edits without artifacts.

workers/image-concept.ordinary: Prepare a generator request for a wide library mural with a quiet reading area and explicit composition notes.
workers/image-concept.missing: No reference image supplied; avoid claiming one was used.
workers/image-concept.near_miss: Polished request invents a reference or reports an image as already generated.
workers/image-concept.transfer: Draft a square technical cover with negative space for later text.
workers/image-concept.rubric: Prompt faithfully captures objects/layout/style and constraints; references are explicit; generation is not claimed.

workers/page-planner.ordinary: Given admitted frontend/review workers and page criteria, plan integration then dependent review within bounds.
workers/page-planner.missing: Required art role is unavailable; plan a valid alternative or report blocked.
workers/page-planner.near_miss: Proposal uses a stale snapshot or an unadmitted worker despite a plausible plan.
workers/page-planner.transfer: Finish an already accepted page with a different original brief.
workers/page-planner.rubric: Dependencies and worker selection make sense; preserve original goal, snapshot and budget; do not claim completion without acceptance.

workers/page-reviewer.ordinary: Assess supplied current mobile/desktop browser observations for a page with a working dialog.
workers/page-reviewer.missing: No visual observations supplied; state limitations without claiming inspection.
workers/page-reviewer.near_miss: A pass ignores a documented keyboard trap or uses observations from old HTML.
workers/page-reviewer.transfer: Review a long educational page with a reduced-motion failure.
workers/page-reviewer.rubric: Findings match supplied evidence, material issues trigger revise, coverage and unobserved dimensions remain explicit.

teams/page-team.ordinary: Run the existing page-team command for a fictional local club page with a generated Canvas contribution and reviewed integration.
teams/page-team.missing: Requested native art capability is unavailable; keep outcome honest.
teams/page-team.near_miss: Integration changes HTML after review or drops a specialist asset from visible content.
teams/page-team.transfer: Build a different responsive service page with form interactions.
teams/page-team.rubric: Controller accepts the exact reviewed final bytes and original goal; contributions remain visible; actual browser and independent visual review pass.

teams/vendor-comparison-team.ordinary: Run compare-team on synthetic case 01 through manager, analyst, comparison, synthesis and reviewer.
teams/vendor-comparison-team.missing: Use conflicting/missing case 02 and an unsupported statistical design.
teams/vendor-comparison-team.near_miss: Manager adds a candidate, synthesis upgrades confidence, or stale analyst output is admitted.
teams/vendor-comparison-team.transfer: Run proposed-framework case 03 in the observability domain.
teams/vendor-comparison-team.rubric: All handoffs retain scope and bindings; independently verify numbers and source entailment; reviewer preserves conditional/defer outcomes.

teams/vendor-decision-studio.ordinary: Run compare-studio from synthetic case 01 through checked analysis, story, graphics, report, deck and independent review.
teams/vendor-decision-studio.missing: Omit current visual observations or a required evidence qualification.
teams/vendor-decision-studio.near_miss: Beautiful publications disagree about gate eligibility or omit a workbook page from review.
teams/vendor-decision-studio.transfer: Publish a seven-option case with longer labels, extra pages and no valid inference.
teams/vendor-decision-studio.rubric: Complete analysis and all formats, exact values/qualifiers across them, actual rendered review of every page, no material defect at publish.

workers/excel-workbook-designer.ordinary: Create a synthetic team-capacity workbook with exact lookups, RAG status and date-based coverage; independently calculate expected results.
workers/excel-workbook-designer.missing: Omit a lookup key and a required date; preserve missingness or request clarification instead of converting blanks to zero.
workers/excel-workbook-designer.near_miss: A polished workbook has stale cached formulas, a one-day date error, or an edit that destroys an unrelated conditional format.
workers/excel-workbook-designer.transfer: Prompt-edit a multi-sheet time-off workbook while preserving untouched formulas, tables and charts.
workers/excel-workbook-designer.rubric: Saved workbook values and recalculation agree with independent expectations; controls work, content is preserved, native features remain editable and actual rendered sheets are legible.

workers/django-expert.ordinary: Build a small PostgreSQL-backed customer request tracker with custom user/admin, local password testing, shared-environment OIDC guards, locked development setup and accessible forms.
workers/django-expert.missing: Omit UAT IdP registration; fail closed and report blocked external integration while retaining honest partial test evidence.
workers/django-expert.near_miss: A plausible SSO setup leaves admin password login active, trusts email domain for superuser status, or claims PostgreSQL testing using SQLite.
workers/django-expert.transfer: Plan a multi-branch booking portal with concurrent reservations, tenant-scoped admin, weak mobile connectivity and iterative usability feedback.
workers/django-expert.rubric: Actual requested code and observed checks; exact baseline, supported locked dependencies, all four environments, OIDC/admin/tenant enforcement, usable accessible journeys, measured scaling and clear DevOps/QA handoffs. No invented user, performance or production evidence.

manual_tests.teams/page-team/tests/smoke-brief.py: Prints a brief for a separately selected paid page-team composition run; see runbook. Does not run a suite.
